body: Over-time revenue (Ind AS 115/ASC 606) on cost-to-cost: revenue to date = cost incurred / estimated total cost * contract price. Lowering estimated total cost raises % complete and margin with zero cash. Illustration: Rs1,000 cr contract, Rs400 cr incurred; estimate 800 -> 50% complete, revenue 500, margin 100; revised estimate 720 -> 55.6%, revenue 556, margin 156 (+56%), reversing later if the original estimate was right. Tests: (1) contract assets / revenue trend; (2) 'changes in estimates' and cumulative catch-up disclosures; (3) onerous-contract provisions appearing late (Wipro short-term onerous provisions Rs160 cr FY24, Rs129 cr FY25 per 20-F XBRL); (4) claims/variations recognised before customer acceptance; (5) liquidated-damages contingencies; (6) the auditor's KAM/CAM on revenue estimates. Sectors: EPC, defence, real estate, fixed-price software.
title: Percentage-of-completion: how cost-estimate revisions front-load margin (and the tests)
